title: Tunisian Kebab with Long Beans
description: A flavorful Tunisian-inspired kebab dish featuring marinated meat and sautéed long beans.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, chili flakes, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb or beef and mix until coated.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the kebabs are grilling, heat the ketchup in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the Tunisian spice blend and stir to combine.
Brush the sauce onto the kebabs during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Meanwhile, heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the long beans and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Serve the kebabs with the long beans and sauce.
